usage.source_scope: 门存在与 open/closed 状态的分离判断。
usage.project_application: 用于门洞候选的状态资格检查，避免“检测到门”直接升级为可通过。
usage.modifications: 不沿用 environment-specific outcome 后调参；新建筑必须视为新 source/cohort，并保留 unknown 状态。
usage.expected_effect: 减少关闭门被误判成当前 passage 的 false-ready。

evaluation.setup: 未执行；最小证伪实验：冻结 door detector，只新增 status head；在新鲜开/关/半开/遮挡集上测 status accuracy、false-traversable 和 UNKNOWN rate。
evaluation.claim_boundary: 环境专用检测结果不能外推到开放建筑或手机视角；状态正确仍不证明净空、路线可达、用户收益或安全。

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
